ns2:section.sectionText: Fundamental concepts of entrepreneurship. Guest speaker topics vary, but typically include: evaluation of technologies and business ideas in general; commercializing new technologies; financing through private and public sources; legal issues; product development; marketing and more. This section is only open to residents in Living-Learning Communities. 1 credit hour. Offered W 5-6:15PM Instructor: Danyelle Michelini; Location: 113 Wardall Hall in the Illinois Street Residence Halls (ISR).
